name: OCR pack: text finder
purpose: Finds the lines of text in a picture. Every OCR pack language needs it.
attribution: PP-OCRv5 mobile model from PaddleOCR (https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR), licensed under Apache-2.0. ONNX file published by PaddlePaddle on Hugging Face.
trainingData: PaddleOCR internal and public data; the publisher does not itemise it.
limitations: Finds horizontal lines of text. Very small, faint or decorative text can be missed.
Results can be wrong; check them before you rely on them.

name: OCR pack: Latin alphabet
purpose: Reads English and other languages written in the Latin alphabet.
attribution: PP-OCRv5 mobile model from PaddleOCR (https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR), licensed under Apache-2.0. ONNX file published by PaddlePaddle on Hugging Face.
trainingData: PaddleOCR internal and public data; the publisher does not itemise it.
limitations: Reads horizontal text. Vertical and strongly rotated text is not supported.
Text in another alphabet on the same picture can be misread.
Results can be wrong; check them before you rely on them.

name: OCR pack: Cyrillic
purpose: Reads Russian, Ukrainian and Belarusian text.
attribution: PP-OCRv5 mobile model from PaddleOCR (https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR), licensed under Apache-2.0. ONNX file published by PaddlePaddle on Hugging Face.
trainingData: PaddleOCR internal and public data; the publisher does not itemise it.
limitations: Reads horizontal text. Vertical and strongly rotated text is not supported.
Text in another alphabet on the same picture can be misread.
Results can be wrong; check them before you rely on them.

name: OCR pack: Chinese and Japanese
purpose: Reads Chinese and Japanese text, with Latin letters and digits mixed in.
attribution: PP-OCRv5 mobile model from PaddleOCR (https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR), licensed under Apache-2.0. ONNX file published by PaddlePaddle on Hugging Face.
trainingData: PaddleOCR internal and public data; the publisher does not itemise it.
limitations: Reads horizontal text. Vertical and strongly rotated text is not supported.
Text in another alphabet on the same picture can be misread.
DesktopTools has not measured its accuracy on Chinese or Japanese text.
Results can be wrong; check them before you rely on them.

name: Transcripts: fast model
purpose: Turns speech in recordings into text. Smaller and quicker; about 3 to 4 seconds per minute of audio on a typical processor.
attribution: Whisper model by OpenAI (https://github.com/openai/whisper), code and weights licensed under MIT. ONNX export published by Xenova on Hugging Face, whose model card states Apache-2.0.
trainingData: 680,000 hours of audio collected from the web; OpenAI has not published the dataset.
limitations: Can mishear words, names and numbers, especially with background noise or several people talking.
Can invent text during silence, music or noise. DesktopTools skips quiet stretches, but check the result.
DesktopTools measured accuracy only in English and Russian.
Results can be wrong; check them before you rely on them.

name: Transcripts: accurate model
purpose: Turns speech in recordings into text. Larger and slower than the fast model, with fewer mistakes.
attribution: Whisper model by OpenAI (https://github.com/openai/whisper), code and weights licensed under MIT. ONNX export published by Xenova on Hugging Face, whose model card states Apache-2.0.
trainingData: 680,000 hours of audio collected from the web; OpenAI has not published the dataset.
limitations: Can mishear words, names and numbers, especially with background noise or several people talking.
Can invent text during silence, music or noise. DesktopTools skips quiet stretches, but check the result.
DesktopTools measured accuracy only in English and Russian.
Results can be wrong; check them before you rely on them.

name: Background removal: high quality
purpose: Separates the subject from the background with finer edges around hair, fur and see-through objects. About 8 seconds for a Full HD image on a typical processor.
attribution: BiRefNet-lite (Swin-T backbone) by Peng Zheng et al. (https://github.com/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet), code and weights licensed under MIT. ONNX file from the author's GitHub release v1.
trainingData: DIS5K, HRSOD, UHRSD and other public segmentation datasets listed by the author.
limitations: Needs about 6 GB of free memory while it runs.
Can keep or drop objects next to the subject, such as items on a table.
Results can be wrong; check the edges before you rely on them.

name: Face finder
purpose: Finds where faces are in a screenshot so Check screenshot can suggest covering them. It does not recognise who anyone is and stores nothing about faces.
attribution: YuNet face detector by Shiqi Yu et al. (https://github.com/ShiqiYu/libfacedetection.train), distributed in OpenCV Zoo (https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo), licensed under MIT.
trainingData: WIDER FACE, a public face-detection dataset, as described in the publisher's training repository.
limitations: Finds faces from about 10 to 300 pixels across; very small, very large, turned or covered faces can be missed.
Can mark things that only look like faces.
Results can be wrong; check them before you rely on them.
